title: OrgDeviceActivity.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe an organization device activity resource.

Apple School Manager API 1.7+

> **Note:** You can add new attributes to a resource without a newer version of an API.

completedDateTime.description: **(Optional)** The date and time of the completion of organization device activity. This is available only when an activity is in a `COMPLETED` status.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time of the creation of organization device activity.

downloadUrl.description: **(Optional)** A presigned URL for downloading activity logs in a CSV format. This is available only when an activity is in a `COMPLETED` status.

status.description: The top-level status of an activity. For more details, see the table below. Possible values: `COMPLETED`,  `IN_PROGRESS`, `STOPPED`, `FAILED`

subStatus.description: The low-level status of an activity. For more details, see the table below. Possible values: `SUBMITTED`,`PRE_PROCESSING`,`PENDING`,`PROCESSING`,`POST_PROCESSING`,              `STOPPING`,`COMPLETED_WITH_SUCCESS`,`COMPLETED_WITH_ERROR`,`COMPLETED_WITH_FAILURE`,`COMPLETED_POST_PROCESSING_FAILED`
